## 1. STRICT RULES & ARCHITECTURE

**1.1 CSS-First Architecture & Zero Inline CSS**
* All styling lives in `style.css`. **Forbidden:** `style="..."` attributes, inline `<style>` blocks, and inline event handlers (`onclick=` etc.).
* Target all design properties, layout rules, and states via class/ID selectors only.
* HTML remains clean, semantic, and style-agnostic: re-skinning the page must require editing CSS only, never the markup.

**1.2 CSS Variables & Theme Tokens**
Define in `:root` (exact names required):
* **Colors:** `--primary: #00F0FF; --secondary: #FFFFFF10; --bg-primary: #020814; --bg-secondary: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); --text-primary: #FFFFFF; --text-secondary: rgba(255,255,255,0.72); --text-success: #00FFA3; --text-error: #FF4D6D; --border-default: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); --border-error: rgba(255,77,109,0.5); --border-success: rgba(0,255,163,0.5);`
* **Glass & glow:** `--glass-bg: rgba(255,255,255,0.05); --glass-bg-hover: rgba(255,255,255,0.10); --glass-border: rgba(255,255,255,0.1); --glow: #00F0FF80; --glow-strong: #00F0FF; --shadow-color: #000000; --blur-glass: 10px; --blur-glass-strong: 20px;`
* **Radii & shadows:** `--radius-sm: 8px; --radius-md: 16px; --radius-lg: 24px; --radius-pill: 999px; --shadow-sm; --shadow-md` (deep black shadows, e.g. `0 8px 32px rgba(0,0,0,0.4)`); glow shadows `--glow-sm: 0 0 12px rgba(0,240,255,0.25); --glow-md: 0 0 24px rgba(0,240,255,0.45);`
* **Spacing & transitions:** `--spacing-gap: 1.5rem; --transition-fast: 150ms; --transition-normal: 300ms; --ease-standard: cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1);`
* **Elevation/stacking:** `--z-dropdown: 100; --z-modal: 200; --z-toast: 300;`
* **Typography:** `--font-base: 'Exo 2', sans-serif;`
* **Contrast pairing (mandatory):** dark backgrounds pair with light text only; when the bright accent `#00F0FF` is used as a **fill**, it must pair with dark text `#020814` — never white-on-cyan. Glass fills pair with `--text-primary`/`--text-secondary`.
* If any near-white surface is ever required, use `#fefefe`, never `#ffffff`.

**1.3 Mandatory Dark Mode — with explicit exception**
* Dark mode is the canonical theme: the complete dark token set is defined directly in `:root` (the default), and all theming remains variable-driven so any future theme is achievable through CSS alone, with zero HTML restructuring.
* **Exception clause:** the source style spec mandates a dark-only experience ("Light/Dark: ✗ No / ✓ Full"); therefore no light-mode palette, no `prefers-color-scheme` light variant, no theme toggle, and no `localStorage` theme persistence are required for this deliverable.

**1.4 Flexbox Layout & Mobile-First Alignment**
* Build **all** layout structures with Flexbox (`display: flex`). Card grids are `flex-wrap` rows with flexible children (e.g., `flex: 1 1 320px`) — no CSS Grid.
* Every flex container defaults to `align-items: center` unless an exception is explicitly justified in a CSS comment (e.g., top-aligned text stacks inside cards).
* Mobile-first: base styles are single-column; enhance at ≥640px, ≥768px, ≥1024px. No horizontal scrolling at any width; no fixed pixel widths on containers.

**1.5 Styling Engine**
* Use clean, hand-written, token-driven custom CSS for this deliverable. All styles bind to the CSS variables above and to reusable component classes (`.btn`, `.glass-card`, `.input-group`); any utility classes used must map back to these tokens.

**1.6 Typography & Icons (Google Fonts Mandatory)**
* Load **Exo 2** (weights 300–800) from Google Fonts via `<link>` in `<head>` and bind it to `--font-base`. Headings 700/800 with fluid `clamp()` sizes; body 400/500.
* **All icons via Google Material Symbols (Rounded)** loaded from Google Fonts. **Explicitly forbidden:** raw inline SVGs, local icon files, emoji-as-icons. Suggested set: `monitoring, insights, shield_lock, hub, rocket_launch, star, check, close, expand_more, menu, arrow_forward, mail, progress_activity, error, check_circle`.
* Decorative visuals (circuit traces, glow orbs, isometric panels) are pure CSS only.

## 2. COMPONENT DESIGN SPECIFICATIONS

**2.1 Button (`.btn` + BEM modifiers)**
* **Default:** `display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem;` minimum touch target 44×44px; `border-radius: var(--radius-pill)`; Exo 2 weight 600. Variants: `.btn--primary` (fill `--primary`, text `#020814`, `--glow-md` shadow), `.btn--glass` (glass recipe, white text), `.btn--ghost` (transparent, accent text), `.btn--danger` (distinct neon-red treatment, Rule 3.5).
* **Hover:** brightness increase + glow intensify, `cursor: pointer`, `transition: var(--transition-fast)`.
* **Focus:** distinct visible ring via `:focus-visible` — `outline: 2px solid var(--glow)` with offset; never remove focus styles.
* **Active/Pressed:** `transform: scale(0.97)`.
* **Loading (`.is-loading`):** `pointer-events: none`, prevents double-clicks/double submission, swaps the icon slot to a spinner (animated Material Symbol `progress_activity` or CSS border spinner) **without changing button dimensions**.
* **Disabled:** `opacity: 0.5; filter: grayscale(1); cursor: not-allowed;`
* **Success/Error (`.is-success` / `.is-error`):** temporary feedback — border/text shift to `--text-success` / `--text-error` plus icon swap; used for form submission feedback.

**2.2 Card (`.glass-card`)**
* **Default:** flex column layout; exact glass recipe (Rule 0.2); `box-shadow: var(--shadow-md)`.
* **Hover (interactive cards):** `transform: translateY(-2px)`, border shifts to `--glow`, glow shadow appears; `transition: var(--transition-normal)`.
* **Focus-within:** card border glows accent when a child link/button receives focus.
* **Loading (skeleton):** `.skeleton` shimmer (animated gradient sweep) with reserved fixed heights — zero layout shift.
* **Empty state:** structured fallback with a centered Material Symbol and clear guidance text (define `.glass-card--empty`; apply to any dynamic area that can be empty).

**2.3 Form & Input (`.input-group`)**
* **Structure:** flex column wrapping a `<label>`, a glass `<input>`, and a dedicated error/feedback container with `aria-live="polite"`.
* **States (all class-driven):** empty, focused (accent glow ring), filled, valid (success border + `check_circle` icon), invalid (error border, `--text-error` message + `error` icon — never color-only), disabled, read-only.
* Glass input: `--glass-bg` fill, `--glass-border`, white text, placeholder at `rgba(255,255,255,0.55)` minimum; use `type="email"`, `autocomplete="email"`, `required`, and `novalidate` on the form so custom JS validation drives the consistent accessible error UI.
* Submission feedback renders inline (button `.is-success` + confirmation message) or as a glass toast (`.toast`, `z-index: var(--z-toast)`, `aria-live`).

**2.4 Modal / Popup (`.modal`) — Demo Modal**
* **States (all animated via CSS transitions):** opening (fade + scale 0.95→1), open, loading (skeleton shimmer while the "demo loads", ~800ms), success/error variants defined, closing (reverse animation).
* **Structure:** fixed backdrop `rgba(2,8,20,0.7)` + `backdrop-filter: blur(8px)`; centered flex container (`align-items: center; justify-content: center`); glass panel with `--blur-glass-strong`, `--glow` border, `z-index: var(--z-modal)`.
* **Content:** after loading, reveal a pure-CSS animated dashboard preview (mini glass panels, glowing animated bars).
* **UX/A11y:** `role="dialog"`, `aria-modal="true"`, `aria-labelledby`; Material Symbol `close` button (`aria-label`); keyboard focus trapping (Tab/Shift+Tab cycle); close via Esc and overlay click; focus returns to the trigger on close; body scroll locked while open.

**2.5 FAQ Accordion (`.accordion`)**
* Each item: glass panel; `<button aria-expanded>` wrapping the question + `expand_more` symbol (rotates 180° when open); answer in a `role="region"` panel animated via the CSS `grid-template-rows: 0fr → 1fr` technique.
* Fully keyboard operable (native buttons); height animation respects `prefers-reduced-motion`.

## 3. CORE UX & MICRO-INTERACTION RULES

* **Responsive by default:** fluid `clamp()` typography (H1 ≈ `clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4.5rem)`), fluid section spacing, wrapping flex layouts, zero horizontal overflow at every breakpoint.
* **Smooth animations:** every state change transitions via `var(--transition-fast)` / `var(--transition-normal)` with `var(--ease-standard)`. Scroll-reveal via IntersectionObserver (`.reveal` → `.is-visible`); only hide content once JS is confirmed loaded (the script sets a class on `<html>` first) so nothing is invisible without JS. Anchor navigation uses smooth scrolling plus `scroll-margin-top` for the sticky navbar.
* **Accessibility (a11y):** body text contrast ≥ 4.5:1 on `#020814` (white ≈ 18:1; `--text-secondary` passes; dark `#020814` text on `#00F0FF` fills passes). Never rely on color alone to communicate state. Semantic HTML5 landmarks (`header`/`nav`/`main`/`section`/`footer`), a single `h1` with logical heading order, a skip-to-content link, logical DOM/focus order, full keyboard operability (no mouse-only interactions), and `aria-live` regions for all dynamic feedback (form errors/success, demo loading, price changes).
* **Mandatory visual feedback:** every click, hover, and submission triggers a visible state change.
* **Destructive actions:** any `.btn--danger` or delete-style action must be visually distinct (neon-red border/glow) and legible in this dark theme.
* **Reduced motion:** `prefers-reduced-motion` disables transforms, parallax, shimmer, and pulses (opacity-only fades allowed); the page remains fully usable.
* **Performance:** apply `backdrop-filter` deliberately on key surfaces, avoid nesting many heavy blurs, and animate only `transform`/`opacity`.
